notes.title: THE BIGGEST CYBERNETIC TITAN UPDATE IS HERE, ITS AVAILABLE NOW TO DOWNLOAD !!!!!
notes.notes:
The Big Cybernetic Titan Remake Update is here, It does Cybernetic Titan justice,

This is the biggest update to ever release for it since launch,
It reworks All animations, Fixes aiming with different sights and optics,
Brings new more detailed realistic textures,
Brings maps with additional detail
Brings improved AI Enemy and User Interface,
Brings Subtitles,
Brings an improved reworked main menu visible on the first screenshot on the store page,
Brings an improved AI Friend,
Makes the game stable and playable with very little issues,

The Update was created with Super Incursion Remake Files,

This update will bring with it New Screenshots, Trailer and New Game Descriptions on the store
This update brings a brand new game cover which depicts the 2 Cybernetic Titan DUO surrounded by CGT forces with MAJOR: Nickolai Patrikov (centre) and Sebastian Garrett (right) in the background overseeing and ordering the attacks.

The build is available now to download play now, Brand new Trailer of the new build will be visible in 6-9 Hours on the store page as the single main trailer.
It will show gameplay of different firearms on different available maps.

The update was created to stablize Cybernetic Titan as at launch it had many issues from wonky walking and ADS animations making it difficult to aim, Some GUNS having miss aligned ADS, cheap guns being over powered, bad loud ai voice lines, unfinished detail addition to certain maps, bad looking UI, rough textures ETC. which all in all with the ones I didn't mention made the whole experience Dull or out right unplayable. This update is here to do the game Justice. Its now fully functional with minimal issues. Enjoy !!!!!

notes.title: MASSIVE CHANGES COMING TO CYBERNETIC TITAN
notes.notes:
Massive new changes are coming to cybernetic titan which will completely change it,
3 new maps and potentially even more
Map- Container Storage, Storage Bay and Quarantine,

Many new guns including AKS-74U/Krinkov, M4A1, WW2 Thompson, WW2 MP-40, WW2 STG-44, FN FAL, Groza are coming.
User interfaces have been all colored dark blue and buttons made lighter blue, many UIs have been modified with buttons reduced in size, cybernetic titan icon added to pause menu, loading screen reworked to resemble the one in IMS Death Squad, new return, confirm and cancel icons added to buttons in many user interfaces.
AS-VAL can be bought in Level 4 list it has been redesigned to fit on hand better, 

A new daytime and weather selection system has been added where you can choose for yourself whether you want it to be Sunset, Morning, Daytime, Night. You can choose between many different weathers including thunder storm, heavy rain, cloudy, windy, foggy, partially cloudy, clear sky etc. and also humidity if rain has not been chosen you can choose whether you want the map to look as if its been just raining outside.

Massive animation rework, pistol, jumping and sprinting animations have been reworked, old animations have removed. tactical reload animations have been added to other guns which didnt have them, shorter reload animations for drum magazine have been added for reloading with a bullet in the chamber.

All enemy voicelines have been removed
On difficult and extreme round end gives you 2 grenades and a bouncing betty.
All grenade models have been redesigned and updated in game and on the mainmenu.
New grenade icons added to advanced station.
You can now throw a grenade while moving at the same time.
Healing Gun model reworked, rotating bandage on the disc while healing with it added and soundeffect added for healing with it.
Player and ai friend wear universal camofluge and enemies cant wear it to separate the two and also universal camo is the standard camo for the IMS Incursion Military Service forces.
Player and ai friend bag packs have been changed to IMS Death Squad bag pack model.
All pistols can be reloaded faster with a new quick reload animation.
Uniqually gun a standard IMS rifle which was previously disabled is making a comeback, this time redesigned and reworked to function well with the new weapon optics and animations.
Petrol station and Crystalville suburbs maps redesigned and renovated.
Massive graphical boost to textures done.

Other changes not mentioned here have been done.

****IMPORTANT**** The updated version of this game is not available yet but in the works*****

Any body who owns this game can leave suggestions of what kind of content they would like to see in Cybernetic Titan, and suggest which guns they would like to use in it. New content and support for Cybernetic Titan will be continued to be brought until further notice. there are alot of upcoming changes after these ones and we are looking forward to you experiencing them.

notes.title: New Gamemodes Coming To Cybernetic Titan In Next Patch
notes.notes:
-New Enemies
We are adding new enemy types ( dogs, exploding soldiers, juggernaut soldiers ) to cybernetic titan, they will be a part of all gamemodes, smaller maps like petrol station wont have juggernauts as there is not enough room to run away from them in the map, 

-New Gamemodes
The game currently has Original Survival Mode and Random Gun Per Wave Mode,

We'll be introducing Base Survival Simulator, a brand new game mode.
it will have its own separate uniquely designed maps, each map will have a base in the center, the player starting with near nothing has to explore the whole map gathering resources which are crucial to survival, like batteries for power, water, food, firewood for barrel fires which increase body temperature, ammo for guns you'll use, find guns themselves and wood plates and sand bags to reinforce the base. as time goes better weapons and attachments will become available on the map to use. the player can return to the base to start the next wave of enemies any time they want. they will have to survive 15 to 20 waves of enemies to evacuate the map with a helicopter coming to pick them up after all the waves have been beaten.

development on this gamemode will begin soon, but it wont be available for some time as we are focused and working primarily on IMS Death Squad a brand new super incursion standalone dlc game which has just began development.

notes.title: Cybernetic Titan Update
notes.notes:
This update add new features and a new gamemode to the game
-there are now two playable gamemodes: original survival mode and random gun per wave mode,
Random gun per wave mode does exactly that, it gives you any random primary with random attachments every new wave
-muzzle flashes have been added to all guns
-bullet hit effects have been added for different surface types.
-oblivion map has been graphically improved,
-new game button in mainmenu renamed to play survival
-refilling ammo at store has had price reduced from 2000 points to 500 points.
-new waves refill your health to full
-text on screen prompting player to take cover and heal appears when health is low
-enemies voiceline sound reduced, enemy deathscreams removed.
-players camouflage changed.

notes.title: Cybernetic Titan V1.15 update soon and V1.16 future content
notes.notes:
Cybernetic Titan is currently on V1.12 that is the current playable and downloadable build. in the next week or so Build V1.15 will release and become the sole main playable build. 
V1.15 adds
*2 New maps- Moonlight Secondary School & Crystalville Suburbs
*New feature- when you die you start off on the same wave you died on instead of starting from wave 1.
*Every brand new wave gives you a medikit, bandage and surgical kit
*Free per-round grenades capped from 8 to down to 4.
*Bug with helmets being inaccessible from the loot window and the store is fixed.
*Armour added to store, its now fully purchasable from there

V1.16 future build will bring the following changes
*4 brand new guns -FN-FAL, IMI-Galil, Pistol grenade launcher
*underground sewer map
*Shipping docks map
*Shopping mall map  
And more additional content.
Patch notes window in-game has been updated with this information.

Thank you.

notes.title: Cybernetic Titan Small Patch V.1.11
notes.notes:
We are currently working on a small patch which will address small minor issues, some of the issues occur to some but not all players And Adds Brand New Content Into The Game.

1.Camera Sensitivity Resetting To Zero 0 - This issue can be solved by opening up the settings menu and under gameplay settings adjusting the sliders for Camera Look, Aim Sensitivity, Acog and Rifle Scope Sensitivity... An Official fix for the issue will be made so players dont have to deal with this problem any more.

2.Makarov pistol slide over retracting - A fix to the makarov pistols slider moving back too much will be performed, to make it retract back to a much more realistic position on the firearm while discharging or unloaded.

3.Additional Hud Elements - New hud elements will be introduced to aid and teach the player how to play the game and perform very well in it. A "use bandage to stop bleed" text will be introduced to nofity players when they're bleeding. 

4.Player spawns on maps moved, Additional Medikits per new wave introduced.

5.New Tutorial map - A brand new tutorial map will be introduced to teach new players all the basic controls of how to play the game and also give them tips on how to play it and perform significantly better.

New Maps And Guns Will Be Introduced To The Game Per Month As Free Updates.
As Well As Significant Graphical Updates And Further Optimization And Polish Of The Game.

Thank You.
